raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-GTM-SmartPublicFinances",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Cyberattacks targeting government financial systems (such as Guatecompras, SICOIN, or SAT) could disrupt PFM operations and compromise sensitive public data.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Establish an Information Security Management System (ISMS) based on ISO 27000, build a CSIRT and Security Operations Center (SOC), and adopt ISO 22301 business continuity standards.",
      "evidence": "Guatemala's cybersecurity context presents a concerning gap between policy formulation and practical implementation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Extreme weather events and climate hazards like storms and floods could disrupt PFM ICT infrastructure and administrative service delivery.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) following ISO 22301 and implement climate-resilient and energy-efficient ICT infrastructure.",
      "evidence": "main climate-related risks for the project are increased heat waves and more frequent and intense extreme weather events"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "A decline in household remittance inflows could significantly reduce Value-Added Tax (VAT) revenues and severely tighten national fiscal space.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), improve public debt and cash management, and bolster domestic revenue mobilization.",
      "evidence": "A decline in these inflows could considerably reduce Value-Added Tax (VAT) collections"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Legacy core PFM information systems are fragmented and obsolete, lacking transactional integration and leading to data silos and manual inefficiencies.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt an integrated PFM Conceptual Model, establish an Enterprise Architecture, and deploy an interoperability platform alongside upgraded IFMIS modules.",
      "evidence": "Core PFM information systems suffer from fragmentation, obsolescence, and weak institutional support."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Lack of data governance policies and data-sharing frameworks limits financial data availability and hampers data-driven public decision-making.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a PFM data governance model, build dedicated data analytics units, and implement a unified PFM data repository platform.",
      "evidence": "Data availability in the repository is limited due to interoperability issues and the absence of a data-sharing framework."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Public sector talent turnover and the absence of structured career paths for data professionals undermine institutional capacity and reform sustainability.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish structured career paths for public sector data analysts, permanent PFM training programs, and innovation centers in MINFIN, SEGEPLAN, and SAT.",
      "evidence": "Governments also struggle to build and retain analytical capacity due to the lack of structured career paths for data professionals"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "High variance between budgeted and actual expenditure composition undermines budget execution predictability and disrupts public service delivery.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement Results-Based Budgeting (RBB) systems, strengthen MTEF alignment with institutional plans, and modernize budgeting and treasury processes.",
      "evidence": "Low scores in budget reliability, particularly concerning expenditure composition outturn, suggest a notable variance between budgeted and actual expenditures"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Weaknesses in public investment management, including poor alignment and lack of lifecycle monitoring, cause project discontinuities and cost overruns.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Reengineer SEGEPLAN planning and investment processes, establish ex-ante appraisal methodologies including climate criteria, and implement multi-year public investment plans.",
      "evidence": "significant weaknesses impact the effectiveness of investment management, including inadequate prioritization due to poor alignment with financial constraints"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Inadequate integration of gender budget tagging (CPEG) across subnational PFM systems limits monitoring and accountability for gender equality goals.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade local government management systems to automate CPEG gender budget tagging across all municipalities and track gender spending metrics.",
      "evidence": "only 112 municipalities out of 340 linked their budget to the CPEG"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "A high public wage bill relative to total government spending creates fiscal rigidity and crowds out productive capital and social investments.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Review the institutional framework for fiscal management of public employment, perform payroll audits, and implement an upgraded Payroll and Pensions Management System.",
      "evidence": "Employee compensation is estimated to represent 40.9 percent of the country's total government expenditure"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Complexities in procuring and deploying modern core financial software and hardware risk project implementation delays and potential scope reductions.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply a phased implementation approach prioritizing core execution modules, establish a centralized PIU, and utilize World Bank procurement support.",
      "evidence": "IFMIS reform projects tend to be costly and lengthy and should be realistically appraised"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "A large informal economy and historically low central government tax revenues restrict public investment capacity and service delivery.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade revenue management systems at SAT, improve municipal property tax management tools, and deploy data analytics to support tax compliance.",
      "evidence": "informal economy accounted for 23.3 percent of GDP, with 71.1 percent of the workforce employed in informal sectors"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Institutional instability and leadership turnover within implementing agencies could weaken political commitment and disrupt reform execution.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Anchor project implementation in the Technical Budget Directorate (DTP), establish active interinstitutional governance committees, and implement a change management strategy.",
      "evidence": "A common reason for the failure of PFM reforms in previous projects in Guatemala is the lack of adequate preparation and institutional stability"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Unintegrated public asset management systems and lack of georeferenced property cadastre data lead to unrecorded state assets and inefficient asset utilization.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Redesign asset management processes, integrate georeferenced property data into the fiscal cadaster, and deploy a modernized public asset management system.",
      "evidence": "the HR and State Assets subsystems are not integrated into PFM, lacking clear regulations and institutionalized operational frameworks."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Delays in establishing the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) or adopting the Project Operational Manual (POM) could delay project effectiveness and disbursements.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize early drafting and adoption of the POM and expedite technical and fiduciary staffing for the PIU within DTP.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawal shall be made under Category 1 until the Borrower has established the PIU"
    }
  ]
}
